items.title: Joey Porter Jr. just dropped a bombshell about playing Week 1 for the Steelers
items.text: The Pittsburgh cornerback is back at practice, but he wouldn't commit to suiting up for the season opener, saying the decision depends on conversations with his agents and team management.

Joey Porter Jr. says it helps that his dad, Joey Porter Sr., has been in the NFL and has experienced this before.

Porter says his dad has been giving him 'great advice' when it comes to the contract talks. 

"He's been giving me great advice. I can't say too much on what he's been saying to me, but he's been giving me great advice. He's been in my corner my whole life, so I wouldn't think he was steering me in the wrong direction."

Joey Porter Jr. on if Benton, Herbig, and Washignton's deals getting done first have been surprising to him:

"No, not at all. I was really just happy that they got theirs done, you know. I came in with those guys, me, Herb, and Keeanu, and even Washington. We all came in together. Those are my guys. So I was ecstatic that they got paid. It's well-deserved. It's well-earned. So I'm happy that they get to feed their families and do what they want to do with their money that they earn."

Joey Porter Jr. says he doesn't believe playing in a new scheme under Patrick Graham will be much of a problem despite missing the summer. 

“I don’t really think it’s a big problem. A defense is a defense. It’s all the same stuff, just different languages. So as long as you get the concept with that, then you should be good overall."
